entities.summary: Jared Gladwyn Butler is an American professional basketball player for Crvena zvezda of the ABA League and the EuroLeague. As a junior in 2021, he was named a consensus first-team All-American and helped lead the Baylor Bears to a national championship. Butler was named the Final Four Most Outstanding Player (MOP).
